verdict.rationale: Graphite docs reference an 'Insights' feature to 'measure and optimize your team's developer productivity' and a way to track PRs across repos, suggesting some org-level visibility, but there is no documentation describing dashboards for AI-review findings, acceptance rates of suggestions, or review-coverage metrics specifically. Missing for 10: concrete dashboard screenshots/specs for findings and acceptance-rate tracking, review-coverage metrics, and any independent corroboration of the Insights feature's content.
